article.story: AMES, Iowa -- — Tre Singleton scored 19 points, shooting 8 of 10, and Jamarion Bateman scored 15 points and Iowa State beat Southern 84-47 on Tuesday night. Dominykas Pleta added 14 points and Ryan Prather Jr. scored 11 for Iowa State. Iowa State shot 24 of 39 inside the 3-point line but just 7 of 28 from beyond the arc to finish at 46% (31 of 67) overall. Reserves Joseph Hunter and Lional Lavardain each scored 10 points for Southern (0-4). The Cyclones built a 20-0 lead within the first five-and-a-half minutes and were never threatened. Iowa State led 41-18 at halftime. Iowa State forced Southern into 30 turnovers and came up with 19 steals. Batemon, Prather and Tamin Lipsey each recorded four steals for Iowa State. Up next Southern: Travels to face Minnesota on Thursday, its fifth straight road game to start the season. Iowa State: Hosts Niagara on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
